flow: existing R5/R6 Task execution and verification
authorityLaws: Goal identity and Goal semantic state belong to Agent Service, not Host Board.
Task readiness is derived; no durable READY/BLOCKED Task state is introduced.
Dependency edges are same-Goal only and cycles fail closed.
Goal graph structure freezes once semantic execution begins.
Goal convergence consumes Task state; it does not infer success from Runtime or Board state.
Board projection failure never rolls back or redefines Goal truth.
Each Goal semantic event has a deterministic Board clientMessageId for exact replay.
Board catch-up projects every unprojected Goal event in event order.
Host Board collaboration records remain explicitly non-domain-truth.
